description: This file defines a React component for listing merchants in an e-commerce admin dashboard. It manages merchant data display, search, pagination, and actions like approve, reject, delete, and disable merchants. It connects to Redux for state management and imports various UI components.

classes.name: List
classes.description: A React component for displaying and managing a list of merchants, including search, pagination, and merchant actions.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component's state with an empty search string.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches the list of merchants when the component mounts.

methods.name: handleMerchantSearch
methods.description: Handles merchant search input; triggers search if input length >= 2, otherwise clears search.

methods.name: handleOnPagination
methods.description: Handles pagination events, fetching users for the selected page.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the merchant list page, including search, pagination, and merchant actions.
